items.title: PM to inaugurate 10th edition of India Mobile Congress on 8 October
items.summary: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi will inaugurate the 10th edition of the India Mobile Congress (IMC) on 8 October 2026 at around 10 AM at Yashobhoomi, New Delhi. He will also address the gathering on the occasion.
key_facts: Organised jointly by the Department of Telecommunications (DoT) and the Cellular Operators Association of India (COAI), the event will be held from 7 to 10 October.
The theme of IMC 2026 is “Scale Without Boundaries”, reflecting India’s growing capabilities in digital innovation, next-generation connectivity and technology-led growth.
The four key pillars of IMC 2026 will be - Srishti: Building the Future; Samvardhan: Fueling Growth; Sashakt: Expanding Opportunities; and Suraksha: Strengthening Trust.

items.title: Ministry of Textiles Concluded ‘Swachhata Hi Seva 2026’ campaign with Nationwide Cleanliness and Awareness Initiatives
items.summary: The Ministry of Textiles successfully participated in the Swachhata Hi Seva (SHS) 2026 campaign, organised from 17th September to 2nd October 2026, with active participation from various organisations, institutions and field formations under the Ministry.
key_facts: Key Activities undertaken during SHS 2026 As part of Jan Bhagidari, awareness and demonstration activities on waste segregation and the Reduce–Reuse–Recycle (RRR) model were undertaken.
These initiatives promoted responsible waste management and encouraged participation of stakeholders in sustainable cleanliness practices.
Participation of Weavers:- The campaign also witnessed active participation of weavers.

items.title: CM of Assam, Dr. Himanta Biswa Sarma to inaugurate Second Regional Workshop for North-Eastern States under Sādhana Śrinkhla (Series) 2026
items.summary: The second regional workshop of Sādhana Śrinkhla (Series) 2026, being organised by the Capacity Building Commission (CBC), will be held at Guwahati, Assam, on 9 October 2026.
items.ministry: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions
key_facts: Heads and faculty of Government Training Institutes, subject matter experts, industry partners and other stakeholders will also participate in the deliberations.
Following the inaugural workshop held at Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, on 29–30 September 2026, the Guwahati workshop will be the second workshop in the series.
Training Institutes form the bedrock of a future-ready, responsive and citizen-centric civil service and have a critical role in realising the vision of Viksit Bharat 2047.

items.title: Additive Manufacturing in India
items.summary: India is emerging as a competitive player in digital revolution through Additive Manufacturing (AM), a 3D printing technology in which digital file controls the process of manufacturing. The National Strategy for Additive Manufacturing (NSAM) is a strategy introduced in 2022 to build India's AM ecosystem.
key_facts: India's Technology Story is Changing Gears Over the last decade, India has moved from being only a user of technology to becoming a builder of it.
This is where Additive Manufacturing (AM) enters the picture.
Additive Manufacturing is becoming one of the newest engineering frontiers of India's manufacturing journey.

items.title: National Institute of Naturopathy, Pune Invites Applications for BNYS Degree Programme for Academic Session 2026–27
items.summary: The National Institute of Naturopathy (NIN), Ministry of Ayush, Government of India, has invited applications for admission to the Bachelor of Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences (BNYS) programme for the academic session 2026–27 at its flagship Nisarg Gram campus, Yewalewadi, Pune.
key_facts: NIN is the first Central Government institution in the country to offer the BNYS programme in affiliation with a Central University, Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri National Sanskrit University, New Delhi.
The 5½-year full-time residential BNYS programme comprises 4½ years of academic and clinical training, followed by one year of Compulsory Rotatory Residential Internship (CRRI).
The programme offers integrated academic education along with extensive clinical exposure in Naturopathy and Yoga.

items.title: TRAI Assesses Mobile Network Quality Across Balasore City under OD LSA, during the month of August 2026
items.summary: TRAI Assesses Mobile Network Quality Across, Balasore, Januganj, Mallikashpur, Remuna, Fuladi, Soro, Markona, Anantapur, Gopalpur, Jamujhadi, Gandibed, Santaragadia, Seragarh, Nilagiri, Amarda Road, Darada, Jamsuli, Chalanti, Nampo, Jaleswar, Baharda and Baliapal etc.in and around Balasore city.
key_facts: The purpose of this drive test is to assess and verify real time quality of mobile network services (both voice & data) provided by Telecom Service Providers (TSPs).
These IDTs have been designed to capture on ground mobile network performance of all TSPs across diverse usages environment like cities, hotspots, public transport hubs, etc.
TRAI, through its appointed agency, conducted drive tests across City drive – 345 Kms, Hotspot locations - 7, in Balasore city during 18th August 2026 to 20th August 2026 in Odisha LSA.

items.title: Commerce and Industry Minister Shri Piyush Goyal Holds Meetings with Leading U.S. Companies in New York to Strengthen India–U.S. Trade and Investment Ties
items.summary: Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Shri Piyush Goyal held a series of meetings with several senior leaders of leading U.S. companies in New York this week to discuss opportunities for strengthening India–U.S. trade and to invite top US companies to explore investment opportunities in India.
key_facts: Discussions focused on expanding Blackstone’s investments and partnerships in India across key sectors.
The Minister met Chairman & CEO of Neuberger Berman Mr. George Walker, and senior members of its leadership team.
They discussed growth opportunities in India, including through increased manufacturing and sourcing, and India’s growing beauty and personal care market.

items.title: Union Health Minister Shri J.P. Nadda to Lead National Launch of JOSH Teams Tomorrow at Bharat Mandapam
items.summary: In a significant step towards further strengthening community participation in India’s fight against tuberculosis (TB), the Union Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, in collaboration with the Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports and the Ministry of Defence, will launch JOSH (Joint Squad for Health) Teams on 8 October…
items.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
key_facts: In the first phase, JOSH Teams will be rolled out across 55 districts in 11 States, with the objective of strengthening youth-led community mobilisation and taking the message of TB Mukt Bharat to the grassroots.

The teams will bring together Class-I Officers, MY Bharat Volunteers and NCC Cadets, combining administrative leadership with the extensive youth networks and community outreach capabilities of MY Bharat and NCC.

The initiative seeks to enable young people to become active partners in the TB response, providing them with a defined platform to contribute to awareness generation, social mobilisation and community engagement.
